name: myCred WP Simple Pay – Stripe Payment Addon
author: WPExperts.io

sections.description:
Important Notice: myCred WP Simple Pay addon is now part of the Toolkit and will no longer receive updates.
📢 Important Notice: myCred Tutor LMS is now part of the myCred Toolkit and will no longer receive updates here.

myCred WP Simple Pay is a free myCred add-on that enables users to reward points on completing a purchase using WP Simple Pay.

WP Simple Pay is a WordPress payments plugin that allows you to accept one-time payments and recurring payments through your website, designed to work specifically with the Stripe payments service.

WP Simple Pay supports non-card payment methods through Stripe such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, ACH debit, and iDEAL.

For the myCred WP Simple Pay addon to work on your WordPress powered site, you should have myCred (Points Management system) plugin and WP Simple Pay Lite.

Features

Points on All Forms: Admin can reward points on all the WP Simple Pay forms.
Points on Specific Form: Admin can reward points on any specific WP Simple Pay form.
Points Rewarding Limit: Admin can set points rewarding limit like day, week, and month.

Plugin Requirements

  • myCred 1.8+
  • WordPress 5.0+
  • PHP 7.0+

DOCUMENTATION

Click here to view the detailed technical documentation. The documentation includes a step-by-step configuration guide and troubleshooting.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Under Search, type myCred Simple Pay Integration
  3. Find myCred Simple Pay Integration and click Install Now to install it
  4. If successful, click Activate Plugin to activate it and you are ready to go.
